hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook that replaces Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity with a bonding-curve invariant backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes trade amounts against a reserve-based curve, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully handle pool accounting.
